newsitem.title: UK: Shell to make statement on U.S. merger talk.
newsitem.headline: Shell to make statement on U.S. merger talk.

text.p: The Royal Dutch/Shell Group is preparing a statement in response to queries about a report that it is involved in a U.S. downstream merger with Texaco Inc and the Saudi state oil company, a spokesman said.
"We have had a few calls on the report this morning. We will be preparing a statement," the official said.

The spokesman told Reuters that Shell would release the statement some time on Monday. But he did not say whether the report in today's Wall Street Journal was true. The Journal reported that Shell's U.S. unit Shell Oil Co, U.S. oil major Texaco Inc and Star Enterprise, a joint venture between Texaco and Saudi Aramco, are negotiating the merger of their U.S. refining and marketing businesses.
The deal would pool assets valued at more than $10 billion and would be aimed at cutting operating costs.
